channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: How to Track Exchange Rates During a Wallet Bridge
item.description: Track a bridge quote from the wallet’s starting token to the amount received, then separate market movement from fees, slippage and route changes before you send.

item.title: Four checks for a pending Mantle bridge transfer
item.description: A pending Mantle bridge transfer can be at different stages. Check the transaction, wallet address, destination balance and withdrawal claim before taking action.

item.title: Turning Sale Proceeds Into a Protocol Stablecoin
item.description: Converting sale proceeds into a protocol stablecoin depends on the token’s chain, route liquidity, fees and the protocol’s accepted asset—not just the quoted price.

item.title: Why Thin Liquidity Can Change a Mantle Exit Route
item.description: When a Mantle withdrawal hits thin liquidity, a provider may route through other pools or assets, trading a faster payout for added fees, slippage and risk.

item.title: How to confirm a cross-chain swap arrived
item.description: A successful send on the source chain is only the first step. Check the destination chain, wallet address and token transfer to confirm the swap arrived.

item.title: Check the Whole Quote Before a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: A cross-chain quote is an estimate, not a promise. Compare the amount delivered, fees, route, timing and expiry before approving the wallet transaction.

item.title: Which USDC should you bridge to Arbitrum?
item.description: Ethereum USDC can arrive on Arbitrum as native USDC or USDC.e. The right choice depends on your app, bridge route and the token address it accepts.

item.title: Ledger confirms wallet implant as MediaMarkt halts sales
item.description: Ledger says CryptoBilis-sold wallets hid LTE implants that copied recovery phrases; MediaMarkt paused European sales after a customer report in Germany.

item.title: How to check a cross-chain swap arrived
item.description: A cross-chain swap can leave one confirmed transaction and another still pending. Check both chain records, the destination address and token before acting.

item.title: Choose the right destination token before you bridge
item.description: Before you bridge, check which token will arrive, whether it is native or wrapped, what the route costs and how you will use it on the destination chain.

item.title: Check These Details Before a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: Before a cross-chain swap, check the exact networks and tokens, minimum received, total fees, destination gas, route steps and what happens if a step fails.

item.title: How to Size Destination Gas for a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: A cross-chain swap needs enough destination gas to finish its final call; estimate the full action on the receiving chain, then price and fund it there.

item.title: Direct destination swaps: how they work across chains
item.description: A direct destination swap lets you choose the token you want on another chain. Learn how routing, fees, timing and destination gas shape the trade.

item.title: A Bridge Quote Is Only Useful If You Compare What Arrives
item.description: Compare cross-chain bridge quotes by the token and amount that arrive, then check fees, gas, timing and the conditions behind each estimate before sending.

item.title: StarkWare opens OffMarket for Polymarket traders
item.description: StarkWare opened OffMarket to Polymarket traders, masking wallet links while leaving trades visible, with a $1,000 USDC deposit cap per account.

item.title: How to Choose a Faster, Cheaper Crypto Bridge
item.description: A good bridge choice depends on what arrives, how long each step takes, and what security model you accept—not just the lowest fee shown upfront for your transfer.

item.title: Dutch central bank authorises Qivalis to issue euro tokens
item.description: Qivalis won Dutch e-money authorisation, clearing a key step toward its euro stablecoin, but MiCA requirements and a white paper remain before issuance.

item.title: ParaSwap: How to choose a cross-chain swap route
item.description: A cross-chain route trades cost, speed and complexity. Compare the full path, check the receiving token and leave room for destination-chain gas before you swap.

item.title: Binance opens AI trading interface after 150,000-user beta
item.description: Binance has rolled out its AI interface after a beta with about 150,000 testers, adding tailored market summaries and alerts while more languages are still coming.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could have created 18 trillion XRP
item.description: XRPL developers patched a payment bug that could have created spendable XRP beyond the ledger’s 100 billion supply; no public-network exploit was found.
